aiRecommendation.title: Job Market Shows Strong Growth Momentum
aiRecommendation.text: Total postings have reached 168,000 this quarter, indicating robust hiring activity across the UAE. This represents a healthy labour market with sustained employer demand driven by Emiratisation and economic diversification.
aiRecommendation.reason: The aggregate posting volume signals strong economic confidence among employers, particularly in key sectors driving Abu Dhabi's diversification strategy.
